# sfcompute_user (Data Source)

Reads user from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/users/{id}`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) User ID or resource path

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `email` (String) The member's primary email, or `null` if they have no recorded email identity.
- `first_name` (String) The member's first name, or `null` if not recorded.
- `last_name` (String) The member's last name, or `null` if not recorded.
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a user resource. Format: sfc:user:<name>.
